dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent 'O' shaped structure at the mid-dorsal apex with a sharp dark-to-light gradient transition; multiple interlocking 'O' and 'C' shaped structures at the posterior-lateral flank with high-contrast perimeters.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low spatial density of small, solid low-intensity pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, localized primarily in the anterior-dorsal region near the neck.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Scalene triangle geometry formed by connecting the centroids of the primary mid-dorsal annulus, the largest posterior-lateral annulus, and a tertiary annulus located on the mid-lateral flank.
